schema_updates: Keep old field keys, order and kinds. Append fields with valid migration defaults.
launching: Installed apps appear in the guest launcher with an icon; title and id are searchable.
storage: The launcher checkpoints confirmed schemas and rows to an explicit host file; no arbitrary file access.
numbers: Signed 32-bit integer cells; sums use signed 64-bit arithmetic. No decimal or currency conversion.

display_control.fields: Exactly one required number field with a valid default 20..100; no filter.
display_control.scope: QEMU software RGB attenuation only; no physical backlight or energy-saving claim.
display_control.execution: Explicit Apply checks the installed app capability. Install, update and restore do not actuate. Reset to 100% with F6.
display_control.storage: Control app schema persists; applied display level resets to 100% at boot.
display_control.updates: Capability is immutable; create a separate app for a different capability.

formulas.syntax: Integer literals, $key references, + - * /, unary minus and parentheses. References only to earlier number/calculated fields; no functions or loops.
formulas.semantics: Checked signed i32; division truncates toward zero. Missing input, overflow or zero division rejects the whole save/update. Required calculated fields have an empty default; ordinary fields have an empty formula.
formulas.updates: Keep editable values, recompute derived values. Validate every existing row before committing the schema update.

user_file_exchange.import: User-selected host exchange folder, inbox/<installed-app-id>.csv; guest previews then appends a validated batch only after confirmation. No model access to file paths or data.
user_file_exchange.export: Explicit user action exports all saved rows and computed values to a new outbox/<installed-app-id>-r<revision>.csv file; existing files are never overwritten.
user_file_exchange.limits: 1..8 incoming rows, existing per-app capacity still eight, exact input or full-field header, printable ASCII values up to 32 bytes. This adds no schema properties or model-callable file operations.

workflow.scope: Optional records.local process. State is separate per record, not a field. No background actions or external effects.
workflow.limits: 1..4 actions; initial/from/to/action IDs max12; labels max22. Reachable graph. Existing workflow is immutable on update.
workflow.guards: none (empty field, value 0), eq/le/ge compare an existing numeric/calculated column with an i32 literal. Checked on every user action.
workflow.persistence: New/imported records start in initial state. Terminal states lock ordinary edits. Trusted saved-session restoration retains known states; CSV contains field data only, not process state.
workflow.execution: Every successful action advances the runtime revision once; invalid/stale/out-of-order actions do nothing.

behaviors.scope: Optional records.local buttons over one saved row. Each press stages a bounded program, previews the candidate and commits only on explicit confirmation at the same revision. No native code or external effects.
behaviors.button: id, label, event=press, steps. Unique IDs. At least one mutating step per button. Installation and restore never run buttons.
behaviors.step: Every step has op, field, value, compare, skip. All references and branches are validated, including skipped steps.

operations.set: Set an editable field to a typed literal of at most 32 printable ASCII bytes. compare empty, skip 0.
operations.calculate: Set an editable number field to a checked i32 expression using ANY current number/calculated field, including itself. Same arithmetic syntax/limits as formulas. compare empty, skip 0.
operations.toggle: Invert an editable check field. value and compare empty, skip 0.
operations.require: Compare a field to a typed literal. Failure aborts the whole press. Numeric eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge; text/check eq/ne. skip 0.
operations.if: Compare a field to a typed literal. True continues; false skips the next skip steps. skip 1..remaining; forward only. Same comparison rules as require.

behaviors.execution: Prior writes are visible to later steps; calculated fields refresh after each write. Failure at any step leaves row and revision unchanged. No loops, jumps backward, cross-row or cross-app writes. Terminal workflow records reject behavior edits.
behaviors.updates: Reviewed compatible schema updates may replace behaviors; preserve existing behaviors unless the user requests a change. Existing workflow definitions and field identity rules still apply.
